dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago : Flores Sea. Tana Jampea and Adjacent Islands
dct_description_sm: Depths shown by soundings, relief by form lines and spot heights.
Primarily in Japanese, with titles and map text also in English.
Tidal information, conversion table, inset chart.
Soundings and heights are in meters.
Publish date "昭和2年" taken from bottom margin.
Shows depths, reefs, low water areas.
